dex.entry: A grown firefly-courier that blazes a trail of lingering glow-motes wherever it streaks, marking safe paths through the dusk for those who follow. It looks fast even when standing still — older players will immediately clock it as a pivot piece.

art.silhouette: Elongated, dragonfly-like frame; four layered wings edged with cyan; abdomen striped amber and cream, tip blazing a permanent steady beacon; big compound eyes catching every glint; reads as a streak of light at 32px.
